column1: # Proof-of-work comparison vectors. SPEC.md §10.5 is normative;
# this file is the machine-readable copy the drivers actually read.
# digest is 64 hex characters in EMISSION order -- the order the hash
# function produced the bytes, i.e. exactly what `hash` prints. It is
# read LITTLE-endian for the comparison: digest[0] is the LEAST

column5: same 32 bytes reversed: the byte-order trap
zero digest meets any valid target
mantissa shifted right by one byte
one over the target: pins <= not <
mantissa shifts out entirely, target zero
sign bit set, mantissa zero, target zero
sign bit set with nonzero mantissa: negative
